subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.**

I will ______ any job offer ______ for the one that requires me to work on weekends.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**accept; except**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Accept**: This means to agree to receive or undertake something that is offered. (जो कुछ प्रस्तावित किया गया है उसे प्राप्त करने या करने के लिए सहमत होना)
